Label or field.description: A classification, extraction, or short structured field.

Short answer.description: A few paragraphs or a compact structured response.

Detailed answer.description: A page-scale analysis, brief, or explanation.

Long artifact.description: A substantial document, code change, or multi-part artifact.

rules.statement: Output tokens are a model-behavior distribution and must not be accepted as user input.
Every cost-visible model must have ordered low, likely, and high output multipliers.
Every cost-visible model must have ordered retry multipliers of at least one.
Primary and checker steps must be included before computing cost per completed task.
The primary result and ranking unit is cost per completed task; volume projections are secondary.
A cost result is a planning distribution, never a guaranteed single generation length or charge.
